title: Railway RRC NWR Apprentice Recruitment 2025 Notification Out

fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Railway Recruitment Cell, North Western Railway (RRC-NWR) has released the notification for the post of various Trade Apprentice. This recruitment has been issued for 2162 posts. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official , Online applying process for Railway RRC NWR Apprentice Recruitment 2025 has started from 03 October 2025 & the candidates can apply till 02 November 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for Railway RRC NWR Apprentice Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

Railway Recruitment Cell, North Western Railway (RRC-NWR)

Railway RRC NWR Patna Apprentice Recruitment 2025

Advt No.- RRC/04/2025 (NWR/AA)

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 October 2025
  • Last Date : 02 November 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 02 November 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Railway RRC NWR Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 02 November 2025
  • Minimum Age : 15 Years
  • Maximum Age : 24 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per Railway RRC NWR Apprentice Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

Railway RRC NWR Apprentice Recruitment 2025 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates who have completed their matriculation level of Examination/equivalent and have scored minimum 50% marks in aggregate along with having ITI Certification in relevant trade from NCVT/SCVT approved Institution will be eligible for this recruitment.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

Railway RRC NWR Apprentice Online Form 2025 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://www.rrcjaipur.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the RRC before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Notification Here –
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for Railway RRC NWR Apprentice recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।

Railway RRC NWR Apprentice Recruitment 2025 : Mode of Selection

  • Document Verification

Answer. To apply for this recruitment, the candidate must have 10th+ITI pass read the official information completely before applying.
